problem:
Find and categorize all the local extrema of the function 
$f(x,y)$ 
given that

$$
{f}^{′}(x,y)=[\begin{aligned}4-4y-4x & 4-4x+{y}^{2}\end{aligned}].
$$

choices.value: $f(x,y)$ has a saddle point at $(4,0)$ and a local minimum at $(3,1)$
$f(x,y)$ has a saddle point at $(4,0)$ and a local maximum at $(3,1)$
$f(x,y)$ has a local minimum at $(1,0)$ and a local maximum at $(5,-4)$
$f(x,y)$ has a saddle point at $(1,0)$ and a local maximum at $(5,-4)$
$f(x,y)$ has a local minimum at $(1,0)$ and a saddle point at $(5,-4)$
